schemaDelta.principle: Galaxy of Intrigue introduces a published weapon whose base damage is a fixed numeric value rather than dice, dash, inherited, modifier, or payload-derived damage. Represent that fact directly rather than inventing a die expression.

requiredEdits.semantics: When mode=fixed, diceCount=0, dieSize=null, and flatBonus is the complete published fixed weapon-damage value. formula remains a display/compatibility string.
requiredEdits.backwardNormalization: No new field is added, so earlier book records require no data backfill. Update verifier/schema acceptance to allow fixed while preserving all prior modes unchanged.

schemaDelta.sourceQualityRule: Galaxy of Intrigue footnote 1 is stricter than the usual Core Inaccurate meaning: affected weapons cannot fire at Medium or Long range. Apply this only to Wrist Blaster and Snare Pistol; do not globally redefine Inaccurate.
representationNotes: Darter uses mode=fixed with flatBonus=1; do not encode its damage as 1d1 or another invented die expression.
Darter payload compatibility does not create additional weapon identities.
Snare Pistol reuses the ranged grab/grapple structures already exercised by Scum and Villainy Snare Rifle, with its own 1d4 native stun and shorter range.
Xerrol Nightstinger remains an Exotic Weapon with rifle-style range behavior derived from its published sporting-blaster-rifle description.

verification.visualSpecifics: Darter damage cell visually verified as fixed 1; Wrist Blaster and Snare Pistol footnote 1 visually verified.

bookLocalGuardrails: Do not update a rolling/master weapon authority from this package.
Do not mutate production packs, template/schema runtime, actors, feats, talents, or equipment records during certification.
Do not create any new production weapon records; all four Galaxy of Intrigue weapon claims are repo-present.
Repo fields are comparison evidence only.
Bump the authority contract to v2.8 only for the fixed-damage enum extension. Do not add unrelated fields.
Do not rewrite prior book facts while accepting v2.8; no earlier record needs a new data field.
Do not convert Darter damage 1 into 1d1, 1d4, or any other dice expression.
Do not treat Darter as Inaccurate; its Short-range maximum is an explicit weapon rule, not Table 3-1 footnote 1.
Do not treat Wrist Blaster or Snare Pistol Inaccurate as the global Core meaning. This book explicitly bars both Medium and Long range.
Do not flatten Snare Pistol 1d4 native stun into normal lethal damage.
Do not omit Snare Pistol ranged grab/grapple, escape DCs, feat restrictions, or 2-shot cartridge.
Do not treat Xerrol Nightstinger as a normal rifle for proficiency merely because the prose calls it a sporting blaster rifle; Table 3-1 places it under Exotic Weapons.
Do not infer Accurate for Xerrol Nightstinger from its sniper role.
Do not duplicate Surveillance Tagger or Redirection Crystal as weapon identities; both remain separate equipment records.

schemaNormalization.change: Introduces v2.8 (damage.mode "fixed"); no prior-book backfill. Structure-only aliases, no published fact changed: pistol range bands corrected to the canonical pistols profile (the package printed medium 41-100 / long 101-200 on 6 range objects; the contract profile is 41-60 / 61-80 and the book prints no pistol-range override); flagged for planner confirmation; Darter: poison payload given a stun object; the surveillance-tagger compatibility entry moved from payloadProfiles[] (damage/effect payloads only) to operation.surveillanceTaggerCompatibility. Additional aliases: Darter Short-range maximum stored as hardMaxSquares 40 (end of the pistol Short increment) with allowedBands derived from qualities (Darter is not Inaccurate); Snare Pistol escape-options triggeredEffect given an effect key. Xerrol Nightstinger weaponGroup "Exotic Weapon" differs from the Phase 1 "Rifle" and is recorded as a documented group override in the registry (Table 3-1 places it under Exotic Weapons).
